theme: Naming the moving thing from its vibration spectrum
title: Aliased Rotor: Naming the Mover from Its Folded Micro-Doppler
strategies: trivial baseline: the checker's own naive reference (candidate row 0, its own range midpoint) -- ignores all observations

greedy: trust the single most Doppler-sensitive aspect angle, assume the observed peak IS the true frequency (no PRF aliasing), match it to whichever candidate class's rate range it implies -- confidently wrong whenever that angle's true line actually exceeds PRF/2

strong: use aspect-angle diversity across the dwell -- for each candidate class and each small integer PRF-fold order, propose a rotation rate and score it against ALL given aspect angles jointly; only the class+rate that is forward-model-consistent everywhere survives
